properties.description: Occupancy equals the independent depth-16 queue count at every eligible observation. Acceptance uses pre-edge model occupancy, including rejection at boundaries, simultaneous transfers, and synchronous reset.
Full is asserted exactly when the independent queue contains 16 words; unknown or incorrect full values raise an alarm.
Empty is asserted exactly when the independent queue contains zero words; unknown or incorrect empty values raise an alarm.

Whenever the independent queue is nonempty, asynchronous output data equals its oldest accepted word, including simultaneous transfers, pointer wrap, and reuse after reset. Empty data is unspecified and is not checked.
Following a synchronous reset edge, occupancy is zero, full is clear, and empty is asserted, including reset during operation. This check remains applicable until the next rising edge.
Public occupancy is within 0 through 16, and public full and empty flags agree with its boundary values. Unknown occupancy or status values are rejected.
